remarks: Discover an exceptional opportunity to build your dream home on this spectacular 1-acre property in the heart of Westport. Centrally located within close distance to Main Street, parks, tennis, and playgrounds, this prime location offers unparalleled convenience.   Property has a circular driveway with dual access, stone wall, and many mature trees and boasts a beautiful, serene backyard setting for outdoor entertaining, play area,s or a future swimming pool. Zoning is residential. Water and electric connections are already in place. There is a septic tank on the property, and the connection to town sewage is also available on the street. The house on the property is not habitable.
